COMBINED PLAN POSITION 7 (epoch:planned-combined-plan-reflow2-and-flo2, agreed 2026-09-27; it was 6 of 10 until two flo2.io increments were added the same night). After position 3.

Step 4 of the tracked-export retirement plan (2026-09-27). Delivers point 3 of req:a-local-client-works-against-a-remote-reflow2-server-by-url, as revised the same day: the client measures local files (artifact registration, drift, reconcile) and sends their checksums as asserted, because the server cannot see the person's disk. The export write-back half of that point is WITHDRAWN (rule 3), so it is not in this step. Follows step 3; precedes steps 6 and 7.

THE SAME CLIENT IS EXTENDED AT POSITION 12 (epoch:planned-the-local-client-opens-files-for-the-tools-that-name-one, revised 2026-09-27 on @ajs's word): there it opens the files that eight tools name, wall_check among them, which completes a person's own agent's full tool set against a design on a server. (Earlier the same night this paragraph gave this client wall_check, reconcile_dependencies and ingest_corpus_step; the last two take their input from the caller and read no file — flo2's fact:only-wall-check-of-the-machine-side-tools-reads-files-itself-2026-09-27 — and wall_check moved to position 12.) And it turns flo2's combined position 2 (the file-evidence tools taking the caller's evidence) from the agent's word into a measurement the client takes.

═══ THE BUILD PLAN, mapped 2026-09-28 at HEAD da4a12b (not started; #616 went first on Anthony's word) ═══
· WHERE: the --remote client, crates/reflow2-mcp/src/proxy.rs: struct Remote (about line 291), Remote::send (312-358), run_remote_with_notice (370-430). Today it forwards every stdin line unchanged, adding only the bearer header and a handshake notice. It detects the handshake by a SUBSTRING test (line.contains("\"initialize\"")), which a tools/call carrying that string would trip. Parse JSON-RPC and dispatch on method plus params.name instead.
· THE ROOT: in pointer mode it is the folder holding .reflow2.toml (attach_to_named_design in main.rs, about 2169). With bare --remote, use --tree-root if given (accepted today but ignored). Otherwise measure NOTHING and say so, rather than guessing the cwd.
· MEASURE WITH THE SERVER'S OWN CODE: crate::measure::measure(root, location, memo). Hashing and path rules then match the server by construction: sha256 over raw bytes as "sha256:<hex>", URIs unmeasured, outside-root refused, directories never hashed.
· INTERCEPT FOUR TOOLS:
  - link_artifact with no checksum: measure location, or the stored one via an internal get_node, and inject `checksum`.
  - set_artifact_checksum, and each checksum-less item of set_artifact_checksums: look up the location, measure, inject. If it is unmeasurable, refuse locally with the server's own wording.
  - reconcile_artifacts with empty `observed`: page scan_nodes Artifact, build `observed` as service measure_registered does (Absent is present:false, other failures are listed, not sent), then forward.
  Rewrite each reply's `measurement` block to say it was measured on this machine by the client and that the server stores it as asserted, so the agent is told the truth either way.
· NOT IN THIS STEP: loop_status's `artifacts` block. It would need the server to accept `observed` there (a surface change); follow up separately. Internal calls use their own JSON-RPC ids on the same session. Tests: extend tests/a_local_client_works_against_a_remote_server.rs, or use the start_registry pattern in tests/a_code_folder_attaches_to_the_design_it_names.rs (tree-less, so the server cannot measure and the client must).
properties.name: [Combined 7] Retiring the tracked export, step 4 — the client measures the folder's own files and reports them to a design on a server
